banner: INFORMATION ONLY — NOT LEGAL ADVICE. This tool reports what Cumulative Web Inc can verify from its own records. It does not grant permission, clear samples, or assess legal risk. Do not sample, interpolate, or release without written clearance from the rights holders. Consult a licensed attorney.
clearance_path: Email CWI Business Affairs at hp@cumulativeweb.com — state the track, the exact portion you want to use, and the use type (sample, interpolation, or cover).
Business Affairs prepares a checklist of the documents needed (split sheets, master-control docs, sample attestations). They do not draft legal language or certify rights.
Clearance is granted in writing by the rights holders; a licensed attorney executes the license.
Do not release, distribute, or perform the new work until written clearance is in hand.

cover.label: Cover (your own recording of the song)
cover.note: A cover uses no original audio. In the US, audio-only releases are typically covered by a mechanical license through your distributor; video/sync uses need direct publishing clearance. CWI's publishing data is unverified — confirm the publisher with Business Affairs first.

interpolate.label: Interpolation (re-record the melody/lyrics)
interpolate.note: Interpolation creates a new master recording, but the underlying composition still belongs to its writers. You need publishing clearance from the writers/publishers, in writing, before release.

sample.label: Sample (use the original recording)
sample.note: Sampling uses the master recording. That means two separate permissions, both in writing, before release: the master (usually the label) AND the publishing (the writers and publishers).
